component.name: jsBudbrainFindDblsOrRenameIt
component.summary: Find duplicate files and rename many files by rules

description.p: Two tools in one: find files that exist more than once and tidy them up, and rename many files at once by your own rules. You see every change before it happens.

ul.li: Finds real duplicates by their content, whatever they are called
Searches all subfolders, finds empty folders too
You decide what stays — the newest copy is kept by default
Narrow the search by type, name, size or date, or find everything else
Trash, move, delete or replace by links
Find any file by name, type, size or date and see where it is
Rename by rules: replace, insert, number, upper and lower case, date taken
Live preview of every new name, problems are shown before anything happens
Try name patterns on sample names before you rename anything
Save your searches and use them again with one click
Run several searches at once as jobs and keep them for later
Moving and renaming can be undone

screenshot.caption: Duplicates found — the newest copy stays, the others are marked
Find files by name, type, size or date, dark design
Rename by a rule: what is found and what it becomes
Try a name pattern on sample names first
Several searches as jobs, each with its result

description.p: First release: find duplicate files and empty folders, tidy them up, and rename many files by rules with live preview and undo, in 47 languages.
